title: Road-trip kit: truck stops, diners, motels and highway pieces
prompt: A prop and building model sheet of blocky voxel roadside America on a flat parchment-cream background, from the high three-quarter game angle: a truck stop with gas pumps under a canopy and a big parked semi-truck; a chrome diner with a neon sign and booths; a one-storey motel with a row of doors, a pool and a tall sign; a rest area with picnic tables and a vending machine; billboards on posts; an overpass with concrete pillars; green highway signs; mile markers, traffic cones, jersey barriers and a highway patrol car; a water tower; a roadside fruit stand; an old pickup truck and a camper van. Warm, sunny, a little worn. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
